settings.field.about.help: A line or two in your own words, quoted into his brief. The one place you shape his character directly.
settings.field.about.label: Describe yourself to Clide

settings.field.enabled.help.translation: Runs a second Claude session for this repository that watches the conversation and comments on it. It spends the same subscription quota as your main session. Off removes it entirely — no session, no strip.

settings.field.frequency.help.translation: Never per message — this sets how notable an event has to be before Clide remarks on it.

settings.field.moodChannel.help: He names how he feels on each remark and the face follows. Off, his expression comes from what his session is doing.
settings.field.moodChannel.label: Let Clide choose his own expression

settings.field.suspend.help.translation: Stops the animation and tears the session down while you are not looking at it.

settings.field.suspend.label.translation: Suspend while the window is minimised

settings.field.userName.help: What Clide knows you as. He is told once and told not to use it out loud.
settings.field.userName.label: Your name
